type Shape = { kind: 'square'; side: number } | { kind: 'circle'; radius: number };

function tag(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
  const rest: never = u;
  return rest;
}

function area(shape: Shape): number {
  switch (shape.kind) {
    case 'square': {
      return shape.side * shape.side;
    }
    case 'circle': {
      return 3 * shape.radius * shape.radius;
    }
  }
  const rest: never = shape;
  return rest;
}

function grouped(u: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
    case 'b':
      return 'ab';
    case 'c':
      throw new Error('c');
  }
  const exact: 'a' = u;
  return exact;
}

function nested(u: 'a' | 'b', v: 'x' | 'y'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      switch (v) {
        case 'x':
          return 'ax';
        case 'y':
          return 'ay';
      }
      const restV: never = v;
      return restV;
    case 'b':
      return 'b';
  }
}

function byType(x: string | number): string {
  switch (typeof x) {
    case 'string':
      return 'string';
    case 'number':
      return 'number';
  }
}

function unused(u: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (u) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
  const rest: never = u;
}

function inBranch(u: 'a' | 'b', q: string | number): string {
  if (typeof q === 'string') {
    switch (u) {
      case 'a':
        return 'A' + q;
      case 'b':
        return 'B' + q;
    }
  }
  const n: number = q;
  return 'n' + n;
}

console.log(tag('a'), tag('b'));
console.log(area({ kind: 'square', side: 2 }), area({ kind: 'circle', radius: 1 }));
console.log(grouped('b'));
console.log(nested('a', 'y'), nested('b', 'x'));
console.log(byType(1), byType('s'));
console.log(unused('b'));
console.log(inBranch('a', 'q'), inBranch('b', 3));
